item.title: Font for italian train tickets
item.description:
Hi to all!

I’m a young graphic designer who has to graduate in september and for my graduation project I want to restyle and redesign the tickets of the italian railways (you can see the actual tickets here: http://www.blinkerart.net/wp-content/uploads/2012/06/grafica-biglietto-t… )

I need help to find a great font that can be used on a train ticket and that can express “italianism” by his shape.

This is the only font that I could find: http://www.campivisivi.net/titillium/maps
